sdkDescCN: wifi通用开发框架，用于所有wifi的联网控制类的设备开发，包括电工、照明、门锁、家电、传感类产品开发。
sdkDescEN: WiFi universal development framework, used for the development of all single WiFi network control devices, including electrical, lighting, door locks, home appliances，sensor and other product development.
sdkVerDescCN:
1、提供极致的配网体验，在使用蓝牙配网的情况下，仅需 10s 即可完成设备配置，配网速度提升 40%；
2、支持 IPv4 与 IPv6 双栈，优化网络延迟，为开发者提供更好的性能与安全性。
sdkVerDescEN:
1. Providing an ultimate network configuration experience, when using Bluetooth pairing, the device setup can be completed in just 10 seconds, speeding up network configuration by 40%.
2. Supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack, optimizing network latency, and offering developers better performance and security.
typeNameCN: 联网单品开发:Wi-Fi设备开发包
